notes: {data} is the downloaded so101_push_rl/ folder and {code} is the repository root; reproduce.sh fills them in.

action, decoder: every 0.1 s the policy gives a fingertip displacement in the table plane (at most d_max_m) and a gripper yaw change (at most dyaw_max_rad). The decoder turns it into 20 ms joint commands (inverse kinematics) and keeps the fingertip target in a sector around the base pan axis: radius ws_r_min to ws_r_max, azimuth within +-ws_az_deg. All curriculum stages and the Chrono check use ws_r_min 0.10 m.

reward: progress toward the goal (position error / pos_scale + yaw_weight * yaw error / yaw_scale_deg), minus time_cost per 20 ms step, w_smooth and refuse_cost; success_bonus at success; invalid_reward plus the time cost of the remaining steps at an invalid end. contact_bonus and w_coverage are off (0). The curriculum stages add a drift cost.

success: the T is within pos_tol and yaw_tol_deg of the goal and at rest (v_tol, w_tol_deg) for hold_steps steps, with no invalid event. The curriculum stages set the tolerances (10 mm / 3 deg at the end).

validity: an episode ends as invalid when a rule fires: arm on the table, a link other than the finger at the T, T lifted, tilted, too fast or kicked, gripper tilted, T motion without the finger near it (unexplained_*), fingertip deeper than penetration_m in the T, T centre within keepout_radius_m of the pan axis. penetration_m and the unexplained_* values were loosened until they flagged under 1 % of recorded Chrono pushes and of their NRD replays.
touch_m: the fingertip-T distance that counts as contact (the dense surface points are 2 mm apart). log_penetration_m is only logged.
